messages:
Maya: UX check: run-history -> two micro-patterns we're debating: 'call thumbnails' (small cards showing tool calls + brief schema badges) vs 'timeline trace' (vertical timeline with collapsible steps). Want a default for next release. Thoughts?
Samir: Uploaded new frames: https://figma.com/s/run-history-thumbs-vs-timeline. Main constraints: list density and ability to quickly find the failing step.
Eli: Keyboard/a11y: timeline nodes must be reachable via arrow keys, Enter to open step details. If using thumbnails, each card needs role=button and aria-pressed for selection. Avoid trap where focus jumps to content pane without clear way back.
Nora: Copy note: use consistent noun: call vs invocation pick one. I vote for 'call' in UI (shorter). Primary CTA on each item should be 'Inspect call' not 'Open'.
Jun: Thumbnail advantage: quick visual scan, badges for schema mismatch, execution time, and status color. Timeline advantage: shows ordering and causality between tool calls. For paging, thumbs compress better.
Maya: Accessibility nits: focus ring must be visible on all interactive elements, timeline connectors should not rely on color alone (use icons/labels). For collapsed step summaries include a text alternative for screen readers.
Eli: Streaming case: timeline can show live progress indicator on the active node. For thumbnails, we can animate a small pulse but must ensure reduced-motion respects user preferences. Add aria-live="polite" updates for status.
Samir: Engineering: thumbnails will be cheaper to render because we can fetch compact metadata. Timeline requires more relational data (parent/child) which backend doesn't currently index. Could add a call_index and parent_id.
Nora: Function defs in the details view: show param list as rows with inline examples and an 'expand schema' affordance that opens a modal rather than in-row JSON. Modal avoids huge inline jumps.
Jun: Devops: ops-bot reports feature flag rollout: feature-flag:run_history_timeline -> canary 5% from 2025-02-02T11:00:00Z.
Maya: Quick poll: reply THUMB or TIMELINE. I'll tally and decide for default. Also need volunteer to draft a11y PR checklist.
Eli: THUMB (better for quick debugging)
Nora: TIMELINE (shows causal flow)
Samir: THUMB (less backend changes)
Jun: TIMELINE (prefer for complex multimodal traces)
Maya: Looks split. Decision: default to THUMB for v1, add TIMELINE as opt-in behind flag. Eli, can you add arrow-key navigation for thumbnails and ensure reduced-motion respected? Nora, can you write the a11y checklist for the modal schema view. Samir, file a small backend ticket for parent_id indexing if we want timeline later. Thanks all!
